scene: The trolley brings you to Grand Transit Hub.
picture: Flat pixel-art side view of Grand Transit Hub. On the far left, a striped water taxi bobs at a canal dock. In the centre, the bearded elderly man in blue flat cap and orange cardigan leans on his wooden cane. Up high rests an open monorail. On the far right waits a red funicular.
